what_happened: Automatic commits titled 'Autonomous funded-order and snapshot evidence' and 'WEP3 actual deployment acceptance' contain receipts with on_chain_executed=false, tx_hash=null, error treasury_signer_missing, x402_simulation_only=true, real_hire_verified=false, live_revenue_cents=0.
expected: Titles and summaries state the actual status (blocked, simulation only) so a reader of git log does not infer that money moved or a real hire happened.

root_cause.text: Commit title is a fixed string in the workflow and is not derived from the receipt status.

rule: Derive every automatic commit title and status line from the receipt's own status fields, never from a fixed success-sounding string.
